name: Binary Volume Rendering (Opacity Thresholding)
definition: A technique where voxels are treated as completely opaque if their scalar density f(x) exceeds a threshold, and completely transparent otherwise. It reduces rendering to projecting opaque voxels or their front faces.
summary: Binary volume rendering classifies voxels as opaque or transparent based on a threshold, projecting discrete geometric primitives to visualize iso-surfaces rather than integrating optical properties along rays.
